finding.claim: validateRealm only rejects IP-literal realm hosts in private/loopback/link-local ranges; hostnames that resolve to such addresses (e.g. cloud metadata 169.254.169.254) pass, so the client sends Basic credentials or the password to an internal host named by the registry.
finding.source: WWW-Authenticate realm parameter in the registry's 401 response (client.go:309-310, challenge.go:67-130), attacker-controlled when the registry is attacker-controlled.
finding.sink: Outbound GET with SetBasicAuth(username,password) (client.go:422-424 via fetchDistributionToken, send at :434), or POST with password form field (client.go:470-494 via fetchOAuth2Token).

trace.note: realm read from Www-Authenticate response header
http realm rejected when registry used https
net.ParseIP on Hostname: only literal IPs are range-checked; hostnames are not resolved
Basic credentials attached to request to realm host
request sent to realm via c.send

finding.guards_checked: Scheme allow-list (225-234); http downgrade check (229); literal-IP private/loopback/link-local check (235-242); challenge origin check (304-306); Authorization stripping on cross-origin redirect (140-157); credentials only resolved for matching registry host (78, 187-192). Not present: DNS resolution at connect time (cf. expertise case 12), hostname-to-private-range check, handling of non-canonical IP literals (e.g. decimal 2852039166, untested). Cross-host realms are documented as intentional; the unenforced 'public hostname' premise is the gap. Verdict PLAUSIBLE, not executed.

finding.claim: Blob mount and sibling fetch take fromRepo without repository-name validation and interpolate it unescaped into the query string (url.go:98) and URL path (url.go:51-53), enabling query-parameter injection and ../ path traversal against the same registry with the client's credentials.
finding.source: fromRepo argument to the public Mount API (repository.go:314-315, 795), caller-supplied; attacker-controlled only if the caller passes untrusted repository names.
finding.sink: POST /v2/<repo>/blobs/uploads/?mount=<digest>&from=<fromRepo> (url.go:94-99, repository.go:805) and GET /v2/<fromRepo>/blobs/<digest> via sibling().Fetch (repository.go:842, url.go:51-53), authenticated with client credentials and token scope.

trace.note: Mount takes fromRepo with no validation
fromRepo feeds token scope via AppendRepositoryScope
fromRepo interpolated unescaped into from= query parameter
ref.Repository interpolated unescaped into URL path

finding.guards_checked: NewRepository (repository.go:185-203) and ParseReference (repository.go:369-389) call ValidateRepository; Mount and sibling do not. Registry host is fixed to the client's own registry, so cross-host redirection is not possible via this path. Verdict PLAUSIBLE, not executed; severity low and depends on caller trust in repository names.
